difficulty_reason: Coskeleton lemma (statement 3418-3428, proof 3430-3475): identifies (cosk_n sk_n V)_{n+1} with the degree-0 part of the mapping object Hom(i_{n!} sk_n Delta[n+1], V) by a Yoneda representability argument; both auxiliary commutations (sk_n with products, i_{n!} with products) are proved in the proof, the second via the internal-hom simplicial set; no verification is omitted. H2: Yoneda bookkeeping with truncation functors.
